classification.difficultyReason: Match vertices across the hourglass using vertically opposite and alternate angles, then set up and solve a direct corresponding-side proportion.

content.prompt: Show that $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DBE$. Hence, determine the value of $x$.

spec.description: Hourglass triangles with A–B–D and E–B–C collinear; matching arrow marks on ED and AC. Decorative orange fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: ED=3, EB=2, BC=x, AC=7; ED parallel to AC.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; no answer supplied.

answer.worked:
$\angle ABC=\angle DBE$ (vertically opposite angles), $\angle BAC=\angle BDE$ and $\angle ACB=\angle DEB$ (alternate angles, $AC\parallel ED$). Therefore, $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DBE$ (AAA).

$$\begin{align*}\frac{BC}{BE}&=\frac{AC}{DE}\\\frac{x}{2}&=\frac{7}{3}\\3x&=14\\x&=\frac{14}{3}\end{align*}$$
